seo.home.title: Thai HTTP and SOCKS5 Proxy | Proxy Server
seo.home.description: Explore Thai-network proxy access with HTTP and SOCKS5. Compare shared and dedicated boards with measured capacity, then manage plans and renewals in your customer portal.
seo.home.keywords: Thai proxy, Thailand proxy, HTTP proxy Thailand, SOCKS5 Thailand, Thai residential network proxy, shared proxy, dedicated board proxy
seo.home.h1: Thai-network proxy access, managed in one account
seo.home.intro: Connect through HTTP or SOCKS5. Choose a plan that fits your needs and the board capacity measured in practice.
seo.home.body: Access exits through internet provider networks in Thailand for authorized testing and verification. Shared plans use a seat on a shared board; Dedicated reserves a board for one account. A public IP may be shared or change with the ISP. Review pricing, quotas and service limits before ordering.
seo.home.faq.question: Does Dedicated mean an exclusive IP?
seo.home.faq.answer: Dedicated reserves one board for one account. It does not guarantee an exclusive public IP, fixed speed or unlimited connections.
seo.plans.title: Thai Proxy Plans: Shared and Dedicated | Proxy Server
seo.plans.description: Compare Thai shared and dedicated board proxy plans for HTTP/SOCKS5. Review Thai baht pricing, duration, quotas and speed caps before choosing.
seo.plans.keywords: Thai proxy pricing, Thailand proxy plans, shared Thai proxy, dedicated board proxy, SOCKS5 plans, monthly proxy Thailand
seo.plans.intro: Compare pricing and limits for Thai shared and dedicated board proxy plans.
seo.plans.body: Each plan states its duration, Mbps cap and quota per period. Availability is checked when you create an order. Actual speed depends on the board, WiFi and network. Payment and allocation must be confirmed before access starts.
seo.plans.faq.question: Does payment activate access immediately?
seo.plans.faq.answer: Payment must be confirmed and a board allocated first. Transfer receipts require review. Payment after a reservation expires may wait for available capacity.
seo.help.title: HTTP/SOCKS5 Proxy Setup and Acceptable Use | Proxy Server
seo.help.description: Set up an HTTP or SOCKS5 proxy with host, port, username and password. Learn to check quotas, expiry and the acceptable use policy.
seo.help.keywords: proxy setup, SOCKS5 connection guide, HTTP proxy configuration, proxy host port, proxy quota, acceptable use policy
seo.help.intro: Set up HTTP or SOCKS5 using your account details and review service limits before starting.
seo.help.body: Connection credentials are shown only to the signed-in account owner. Open My plans to find the host, port, username and password. Do not share these credentials. Check account status if you cannot connect.
seo.help.faq.question: What should I check if I cannot connect?
seo.help.faq.answer: Check the current host and port, password, expiry, period quota and order status. Then update the settings in your app.
